intro.text: A Windrunner and member of Bridge Thirteen.

items.text: Isasik ran bridges in Sadeas's army as a member of Bridge Thirteen. Freed by Dalinar Kholin along with his crew, he joined the Kholin army, trained as a soldier and bodyguard, and guarded the Kholin family at Urithiru.
Isasik became one of Teft's squires with the rest of Bridge Thirteen and, in the year that followed, bonded his own spren and became a full Windrunner.

Isasik joined the raid on a Ghostblood safehouse in Narak, then went with Breteh into Shadesmar to look for escapees. Three Ghostbloods disguised as guards turned on them, and Iyatil cut his throat; Renarin healed him, and Isasik and Breteh then flew down to free the real guards.
